name: Wild Clusters

features.name: Cluster chain reactions
features.description: Clusters pay and refill for chain wins.

features.name: Galaxy features
features.description: Filling a meter with 25 winning symbols triggers a random feature, such as adding 3–6 wilds.

review:
A bright space cluster game with chain reactions, mega symbols and Galaxy features. Progress meters next to the reels fill up as you land winning symbols.

When a meter hits 25, a Galaxy feature fires at the end of the spin – one adds three to six wilds and blows up the symbols around them. Those meters give the base game a real sense of building towards something. Very high volatility, 5,000x max and 96.71% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
